# Editor, boards & sharing

A file editor, whiteboards per project, and threads you can share by link, move to another machine or clean up.

Pack id `files`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/editor`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/editor/README.md) — Monaco file editor for DSH: workspace file tree, tabs, open-from-anywhere and confined saving.
2. [`@dshfiles/whiteboard`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/whiteboard/README.md) — Per-project Excalidraw whiteboards stored on the Host, with agent tools to list, read, write and delete them.
3. [`@dshfiles/thread-share`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/thread-share/README.md) — Share one DSH thread as a read-only live or snapshot page behind an unguessable link, optionally passphrase-protected, with expiry, revoke and view counts; plus a self-contained HTML export and an opt-in, time-bounded Tailscale Funnel / cloudflared publish helper.
4. [`@dshfiles/thread-transfer`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/thread-transfer/README.md) — Export a thread to a portable .dshthread bundle (messages, tool calls, attachments, title, model) and import one as a new thread on another machine.
5. [`@dshfiles/conversation-cleanup`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/conversation-cleanup/README.md) — Preview and permanently purge cold settled or archived local conversations under their native write locks.

## Prerequisites

1. A project is added.

## Key settings

None.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Editor, boards & sharing under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `files`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs files` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
